assumptions.statement: The team is operating in an AWS environment where Elastic File System (EFS) is available and suitable for their use case.
assumptions.quote: In AWS, we have the option to use [Elastic File System (EFS)](https://aws.amazon.com/efs).

assumptions.statement: The existing instances (backend, whitehall-backend, asset-slave) are capable of mounting the new filesystem in the same manner as the previous NFS share.
assumptions.quote: Each instance would have to mount this filesystem in the same way as NFS

assumptions.statement: The asset-master instance requires direct access to move files within the filesystem after virus scans, necessitating its mount to the shared resource.
assumptions.quote: The asset-master is required to mount because it moves files about the filesystem after running virus scans.
